about.author_brandmeister: Special thanks to the authors, developers, and sponsors of BrandMeister — without them, this advanced ecosystem and great community would not exist
about.desc_brandmeister: Connection to BrandMeister DMR network via Homebrew Repeater protocol and REST API v2.
about.desc_crypto: Cryptographic security, automated SSL/TLS certificate generation, and secure WSS connections.
about.desc_dmrutils: Python 3 library for DMR frame parsing, HomeBrew repeater protocol, and AMBE processing.
about.desc_dsdfme: Speech synthesis and decoding of IMBE and AMBE+2 vocoders for DMR digital radio.
about.desc_fastapi: Asynchronous high-performance web framework for API endpoints and WebSocket gateway.
about.desc_ffmpeg: Universal multimedia framework for encoding, compression, and converting on-air radio recordings to MP3.
about.desc_imbe: Fixed-Point DSP implementation of IMBE/AMBE speech vocoder for efficient compression.
about.desc_mbelib: Original DSP speech synthesis library mbelib and fixed-point imbe_vocoder for TX voice encoding.
about.desc_mmdvm: HomeBrew Repeater and Hotspot protocol for connecting with BM Master servers.
about.desc_piper: Fast local neural text-to-speech engine (TTS) for voice announcements of callsigns and talkgroups.
about.desc_radioid: Open global amateur radio DMR ID registration database and callsign directory.
about.desc_sqlite: Robust embedded relational database engine and async driver powering user accounts, settings, and logs.
about.desc_tailscale: Secure WireGuard-based mesh VPN providing zero-configuration remote access to ProxDMR server from anywhere.
about.desc_uvicorn: Lightning-fast ASGI web server implementation for async Python applications.
about.desc_webaudio: Browser low-latency DSP audio pipeline: AGC, 3-band parametric EQ, presence filter, and TS1/TS2 stereo routing.
about.desc_websockets: Real-time audio streaming and telemetry via WebSockets.
about.title: About Station

dsdfme.hint_audio_gain: DSD-FME speech synthesizer amplitude multiplier (-g). 6.5x–7.0x is DMR factory optimum. Values above 8.0x cause distortion and clipping.

dsdfme.hint_fec_tolerance: Determines how many corrupt bits are tolerated before muting a frame.
dsdfme.hint_max_repeats: Frame repeat limit on packet drop or uncorrectable errors. 0 — silence, 3 — DMR standard, 4–10 — maximum smoothing.
dsdfme.hint_repeat_decay: Harmonic amplitude fade rate during frame repeats. Eliminates robotic drone during packet drops. 75% — gentle fade, 100% — constant volume.
dsdfme.hint_spectral_enh: Emphasizes voice formants for greater clarity on the speaker.
dsdfme.hint_synthesis_mode: Float mode provides optimal dynamic range and lower distortion.
dsdfme.hint_uvquality: Number of harmonics for unvoiced consonant synthesis ('s', 'sh', 'f'). 1 is minimum, 3–4 is clean and smooth (optimal), 6–8 is maximum. Higher values cause digital crackle.

transcriber.help_header: ✨ How to get a free Gemini API key:
transcriber.help_step1: Open the link: Google AI Studio.
transcriber.help_step2: Sign in with your Google account.
transcriber.help_step4: Select «Create API key in new project» (or choose an existing project).
transcriber.help_step5: Copy the created key and paste it into the application settings.
transcriber.help_tier_note: 💎 Free Tier: The free tier is active by default and does not require billing info or a credit card.
transcriber.keys_hint: Free key from Google AI Studio (up to 15 req/min per key). Multiple keys from different Google accounts distribute free requests. A paid API key can also be used for higher limits and advanced models.
